title: 10-Year Trust Fund Projections
description: CBO's baseline projections of trust fund balances, deficits/surpluses, and detailed OASI/DI/HI trust fund income, expenditures, and balances.

notes.actual_year: The first column is the most recent actual year; remaining columns are projections.

tables.surpluses: Table B-2 / Table 2 — Trust Fund Deficits and Surpluses
